attributes.title: 2027 NASW National Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 NASW National Conference is scheduled for June 21 to 25, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in Portland. The theme is "Navigating Uncertainty. Strengthening Service. Influencing the Future." The Hyatt Regency Portland next to the convention center is the headquarters hotel.

NASW has posted in-person rates ahead of opening the registration site: NASW members pay $555 early bird, $620 regular and $760 on-site; non-members pay $810, $945 and $1,260; BSW and MSW student members pay from $265, and retired members from $280. Pre-conference workshops cost $145 for members and $195 for non-members. The proposal window closed on November 16, 2026. Virtual fees, the number of social work CE contact hours and the session program are not published yet.
